title: Onboarding
description: The first-run welcome: an account or this computer only, identities, what each identity syncs, the vault's Emergency Kit.

toc.title: Signing in to the machine with the account (greeter): not built

Before this, a fresh Palmy install had no way to create or sign in to
the Palmy account, set up identities or choose what syncs: the cloud was
reachable only through CLI demos.

is that way. It opens once
per person at their first login, and anyone can run it again later.

is the model (one account, several identities, nothing crosses
silently).
